name: ploaness-workspace
description: Workspace root for ploaness, the external quality harness for Payload CMS projects
author: Herman Ciechanowiec <herman@ciechanowiec.eu>

scripts.verify:fast: pnpm run build && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run lint:eslint && pnpm run test

typographyExclusions.reason: Vale detector definitions, whose content is the character they detect

javascriptAllowlist.reason: ESLint's own flat config, which its loader reads as JavaScript unless jiti is added

vulnerabilityAllowlist.reason: braces 3.0.3 is reached only through micromatch in fast-glob, under @next/eslint-plugin-next, stylelint's globby and type-coverage; the stack exhaustion needs a deeply nested brace pattern, and the only patterns braces expands there are the file globs of analyzer configurations the harness and the repository author. There is no upgrade: 3.0.3 is the latest release of braces
